experiment: SG-combined-v3: single changes to the V3 capped hierarchy (per-head cap, native coarse seed, temporal cap)

cell_definitions.R0: same-generation observation-wise FINE-P2 (v2 V0); registered selection reference
cell_definitions.R1: SG-combined-v2 V3 replay: r16_t = mean_h A16 c16, z32_t = cap(r16_t, mean_h A32 U r16_t), R1 = mean_t mean_h A64 U z32_t; local mechanism reference
cell_definitions.W1: R1 with every 32-px head capped against the head-mean parent before averaging: z32_t = mean_h cap(r16_t, A32_h U r16_t)
cell_definitions.W2: R1 started from c16* = minmax(S_<=16), the native 8/16-px share of the selected A3 sum with unchanged A3 weights (S = S_64 + S_<=16), instead of c16 = area-downsampled c64
cell_definitions.W3: R1 with a temporal cap: z_t = cap(D_64->32(mean_{t'<t} v_t'), v_t) for calls after the first, v_t = R1's per-call map; first call unchanged

seed: historical A3 (Section 107 orientation), owner decision 31 October 2026; A3G only if a later result warrants it
cap: SG-combined-v2 one-sided raw-space cap, epsilon 1e-12, clipped mass discarded
ca: frozen A3 class-word W: SD1.5, selected eleven CA modules (64-px 0,1,13,14,15; 16-px 4,5,7,8,9; 8-px 6), calls 0-30, all heads
sa: SG25/SG33 sources 16/32/64, matched calls 10-20, eight heads; no head pairing across modules
selection: five frozen VOC folds; raw and R2 screens separately versus same-generation R0 with candidates R1, W1, W2, W3; registered promotion guard unchanged; full-VOC thresholds frozen for COCO; no COCO tuning
mechanism_table: W1, W2, W3 versus R1, raw and R2: forced OOF delta, fold wins, paired mean-image interval, frozen and best-threshold COCO delta, raw AP; reported separately from the selector

decision_rules.W2: final-method candidate if it beats R1 in >=4/5 folds with paired interval above zero (raw or R2) and sheep IoU does not fall versus R1
decision_rules.W1: closed if sheep IoU falls versus R1
decision_rules.W3: temporal capping closed unless it beats R1 in >=4/5 folds with paired interval above zero

diagnostics: GT cap loss at 16->32 for R1, W1 (head-wise) and W2: gamma_GT (GT-weighted binding share), L_GT and L_background (removed proposal-mass shares), by class; cap binding/removed-mass per cell; c16*/c16 Pearson r and mean absolute difference; IoU change by GT area bin; worst class; raw AP and best-threshold mIoU. Diagnostic only
dense_maps: fp16 min-max 64x64 pre-CRF maps of all five cells for every image in the diagnostic sidecar (owner-approved departure from the no-dense-map rule)
storage: resumable per-image confusion counts plus the compact and dense diagnostic sidecar; no generated image, QK or affinity cache
